description: Main window permissions: window dragging, directory dialog, window creation for multi-workspace — remote: the shell navigates the window to the sidecar's http://127.0.0.1:<port> origin, so these permissions extend to that remote page. ω99-275: #7 — allow-get-pet-skin: the main window reads the persisted pet skin (get_pet_skin) to stamp html[data-pet-skin], so assistant-message avatars follow the pet's current skin. ω99-287: #2 — allow-hide/allow-destroy: the background-on-close fork (route W) — the main window's JS close-requested listener turns the red X into hide (setting on) or destroy (setting off, the old quit path; destroy, NOT close — close re-emits close-requested and would loop). 117 vibrancy: allow-set-theme — applyTheme drives the WINDOW theme (and with it the sidebar material's light/dark) in the same seam as the CSS data-theme switch; a mismatched pair puts a light page on dark glass
